passages.text: “And you, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel and say: O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Ezekiel.
God called Ezekiel "son of man."
God commanded Ezekiel to prophesy.
God told Ezekiel to speak to the mountains of Israel.
God said, "Mountains of Israel, listen."
God said, "Hear the word of the LORD."
passages.original: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־ אָדָ֔ם הִנָּבֵ֖א אֶל־ הָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְאָ֣מַרְתָּ֔ הָרֵי֙ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר־ יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: This is what the Lord GOD says: Because the enemy has said of you, ‘Aha! The ancient heights have become our possession,’ therefore prophesy and declare that this is what the Lord GOD says: Because they have made you desolate and have trampled you on every side, so that you became a possession of the rest of the nations and were taken up in slander by the lips of their talkers, therefore, O mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD. This is what the Lord GOD says to the mountains and hills, to the ravines and valleys, to the desolate ruins and abandoned cities, which have become a spoil and a mockery to the rest of the nations around you.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
The Lord GOD addresses the mountains of Israel.
The Lord GOD also addresses the hills, ravines, and valleys.
The Lord GOD includes the desolate ruins and abandoned cities.
These places have become a spoil and a mockery.
The nations around Israel have taken these places for themselves.
The enemy said, “Aha! The ancient heights now belong to us.”
The enemy made the land of Israel desolate.
The enemy trampled Israel on every side.
Israel became a possession for the rest of the nations.
People spoke slander against Israel.
They used their lips to spread rumors about Israel.
Therefore, the Lord GOD commands a prophecy.
The Lord GOD says, “O mountains of Israel, hear My word.”
passages.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֣עַן אָמַ֧ר הָאוֹיֵ֛ב עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם הֶאָ֑ח וּבָמ֣וֹת עוֹלָ֔ם לְמֽוֹרָשָׁ֖ה הָ֥יְתָה לָּֽנוּ׃ לָכֵן֙ הִנָּבֵ֣א וְאָמַרְתָּ֔ כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֖ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה יַ֣עַן בְּיַ֡עַן שַׁמּוֹת֩ וְשָׁאֹ֨ף אֶתְכֶ֜ם מִסָּבִ֗יב לִֽהְיוֹתְכֶ֤ם מֽוֹרָשָׁה֙ לִשְׁאֵרִ֣ית הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וַתֵּֽעֲל֛וּ עַל־ שְׂפַ֥ת לָשׁ֖וֹן וְדִבַּת־ עָֽם׃ לָכֵן֙ הָרֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שִׁמְע֖וּ דְּבַר־ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֑ה כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְ֠הוִה לֶהָרִ֨ים וְלַגְּבָע֜וֹת לָאֲפִיקִ֣ים וְלַגֵּאָי֗וֹת וְלֶחֳרָב֤וֹת הַשֹּֽׁמְמוֹת֙ וְלֶעָרִ֣ים הַנֶּעֱזָב֔וֹת אֲשֶׁ֨ר הָי֤וּ לְבַז֙ וּלְלַ֔עַג לִשְׁאֵרִ֥ית הַגּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר מִסָּבִֽיב׃ס

passages.text: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Surely in My burning zeal I have spoken against the rest of the nations, and against all Edom, who took My land as their own possession with wholehearted joy and utter contempt, so that its pastureland became plunder.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks with authority.
He says this to the people.
He has burning zeal.
He has spoken against the rest of the nations.
He has spoken against all of Edom.
These nations took God's land for themselves.
They claimed it as their own possession.
They did this with wholehearted joy.
They acted with utter contempt.
They turned the land's pastureland into plunder.
passages.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּֽה־ אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ אִם־ לֹ֠א בְּאֵ֨שׁ קִנְאָתִ֥י דִבַּ֛רְתִּי עַל־ שְׁאֵרִ֥ית הַגּוֹיִ֖ם וְעַל־ אֱד֣וֹם כֻּלָּ֑א אֲשֶׁ֣ר נָתְנֽוּ־ אֶת־ אַרְצִ֣י׀ לָ֠הֶם לְמ֨וֹרָשָׁ֜ה בְּשִׂמְחַ֤ת כָּל־ לֵבָב֙ בִּשְׁאָ֣ט נֶ֔פֶשׁ לְמַ֥עַן מִגְרָשָׁ֖הּ לָבַֽז׃

passages.text: Therefore, prophesy concerning the land of Israel and tell the mountains and hills, the ravines and valleys, that this is what the Lord GOD says: Behold, I have spoken in My burning zeal because you have endured the reproach of the nations.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks to the land of Israel.
He addresses the mountains and hills.
He addresses the ravines and valleys.
The Lord GOD says this:
I have spoken with burning zeal.
I have spoken with anger.
You have carried the shame of the nations.
You have endured their reproach.
Therefore, I speak to you now.
passages.original: לָכֵ֕ן הִנָּבֵ֖א עַל־ אַדְמַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֡ לֶהָרִ֣ים וְ֠לַגְּבָעוֹת לָאֲפִיקִ֨ים וְלַגֵּאָי֜וֹת כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה הִנְנִ֨י בְקִנְאָתִ֤י וּבַחֲמָתִי֙ דִּבַּ֔רְתִּי יַ֛עַן כְּלִמַּ֥ת גּוֹיִ֖ם נְשָׂאתֶֽם׃

passages.text: Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: I have sworn with an uplifted hand that surely the nations around you will endure reproach of their own.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He is the God of Israel.
He says, "I have lifted My hand and sworn."
The nations surround Israel.
These nations have shamed Israel.
These nations will bear their own shame.
passages.original: לָכֵ֗ן כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אֲנִ֖י נָשָׂ֣אתִי אֶת־ יָדִ֑י אִם־ לֹ֤א הַגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָכֶ֣ם מִסָּבִ֔יב הֵ֖מָּה כְּלִמָּתָ֥ם יִשָּֽׂאוּ׃

passages.text: But you, O mountains of Israel, will produce branches and bear fruit for My people Israel, for they will soon come home.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks to the mountains of Israel.
The mountains of Israel will grow branches.
The mountains of Israel will bear fruit.
The fruit is for the people of Israel.
The people of Israel will soon return home.
passages.original: וְאַתֶּ֞ם הָרֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ עַנְפְּכֶ֣ם תִּתֵּ֔נוּ וּפֶרְיְכֶ֥ם תִּשְׂא֖וּ לְעַמִּ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֥י קֵרְב֖וּ לָבֽוֹא׃

passages.text: For behold, I am on your side; I will turn toward you, and you will be tilled and sown.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the mountains of Israel.
God says, "I am on your side."
I will turn toward you.
People will till you.
People will sow seed in you.
passages.original: כִּ֖י הִנְנִ֣י אֲלֵיכֶ֑ם וּפָנִ֣יתִי אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וְנֶעֱבַדְתֶּ֖ם וְנִזְרַעְתֶּֽם׃

passages.text: I will multiply the people upon you—the house of Israel in its entirety. The cities will be inhabited and the ruins rebuilt.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the land of Israel.
God promises to increase the number of people on the land.
God will bring back all the people of Israel.
Every family of Israel will return.
The cities will have people living in them again.
The ruined places will be built again.
passages.original: וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֤י עֲלֵיכֶם֙ אָדָ֔ם כָּל־ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל כֻּלֹּ֑ה וְנֹֽשְׁבוּ֙ הֶֽעָרִ֔ים וְהֶחֳרָב֖וֹת תִּבָּנֶֽינָה׃

passages.text: I will fill you with people and animals, and they will multiply and be fruitful. I will make you as inhabited as you once were, and I will make you prosper more than before. Then you will know that I am the LORD.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to Israel.
God promises to bless the land.
God says, "I will fill you with people."
I will fill you with animals.
The people will multiply.
The animals will multiply.
The people will be fruitful.
The animals will be fruitful.
I will make you as full of life as you were before.
I will make you prosper more than you did at first.
Then you will know that I am the LORD.
passages.original: וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֧י עֲלֵיכֶ֛ם אָדָ֥ם וּבְהֵמָ֖ה וְרָב֣וּ וּפָר֑וּ וְהוֹשַׁבְתִּ֨י אֶתְכֶ֜ם כְּקַדְמֽוֹתֵיכֶ֗ם וְהֵטִֽבֹתִי֙ מֵרִאשֹׁ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Yes, I will cause My people Israel to walk upon you; they will possess you, and you will be their inheritance, and you will no longer deprive them of their children.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the land of Israel.
God says He will bring people onto the land.
God will bring His people, the people of Israel.
The people of Israel will walk on the land.
The people of Israel will possess the land.
The land will belong to them as an inheritance.
The land will not take away their children anymore.
The land will not cause them to lose their children again.
passages.original: וְהוֹלַכְתִּי֩ עֲלֵיכֶ֨ם אָדָ֜ם אֶת־ עַמִּ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וִֽירֵשׁ֔וּךָ וְהָיִ֥יתָ לָהֶ֖ם לְנַחֲלָ֑ה וְלֹא־ תוֹסִ֥ף ע֖וֹד לְשַׁכְּלָֽם׃ס

passages.text: For this is what the Lord GOD says: Because people say to you, ‘You devour men and deprive your nation of its children,’ therefore you will no longer devour men or deprive your nation of its children, declares the Lord GOD.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He addresses the land of Israel.
People accuse the land.
They say, “You devour men.”
They say, “You deprive your nation of its children.”
The Lord GOD responds.
He says, “You will not devour men anymore.”
He says, “You will not deprive your nation of its children anymore.”
The Lord GOD declares this.
passages.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה יַ֚עַן אֹמְרִ֣ים לָכֶ֔ם אֹכֶ֥לֶת אָדָ֖ם אָתִּי וּמְשַׁכֶּ֥לֶת גּוֹיֵךְ הָיִֽית׃ לָכֵ֗ן אָדָם֙ לֹא־ תֹ֣אכְלִי ע֔וֹד וְגוֹיֵךְ לֹ֣א תְכַשְּׁלִי ע֑וֹד נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃

passages.text: I will no longer allow the taunts of the nations to be heard against you, and you will no longer endure the reproach of the peoples or cause your nation to stumble, declares the Lord GOD.”
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks to the land of Israel.
He says, “I will not let you hear the insults of the nations anymore.
You will not carry the shame from other peoples again.
You will not make your nation stumble again.
This is what the Lord GOD declares.”
passages.original: וְלֹא־ אַשְׁמִ֨יעַ אֵלַ֤יִךְ עוֹד֙ כְּלִמַּ֣ת הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְחֶרְפַּ֥ת עַמִּ֖ים לֹ֣א תִשְׂאִי־ ע֑וֹד וְגוֹיֵךְ לֹא־ תַכְשִׁ֣לִי ע֔וֹד נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ס

passages.text: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying, “Son of man, when the people of Israel lived in their land, they defiled it by their own ways and deeds. Their behavior before Me was like the uncleanness of a woman’s impurity.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me again.
He said these words to me.
He called me “son of man.”
The people of Israel lived in their own land.
They defiled the land.
They did this by their own ways.
They did this by their own deeds.
Their behavior before Me was unclean.
Their ways were like the uncleanness of a woman’s impurity.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃ בֶּן־ אָדָ֗ם בֵּ֤ית יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ יֹשְׁבִ֣ים עַל־ אַדְמָתָ֔ם וַיְטַמְּא֣וּ אוֹתָ֔הּ בְּדַרְכָּ֖ם וּבַעֲלִֽילוֹתָ֑ם כְּטֻמְאַת֙ הַנִּדָּ֔ה הָיְתָ֥ה דַרְכָּ֖ם לְפָנָֽי׃

passages.text: So I poured out My wrath upon them because of the blood they had shed on the land, and because they had defiled it with their idols.
passages.sermon:
God saw the people of Israel.
They lived in their own land.
They did evil things.
They killed others and spilled blood on the land.
They worshiped idols.
They made the land unclean with their idols.
God became angry with them.
God poured out His wrath on them because of the blood they shed.
God also punished them because they defiled the land with idols.
passages.original: וָאֶשְׁפֹּ֤ךְ חֲמָתִי֙ עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם עַל־ הַדָּ֖ם אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁפְכ֣וּ עַל־ הָאָ֑רֶץ וּבְגִלּוּלֵיהֶ֖ם טִמְּאֽוּהָ׃

passages.text: I dispersed them among the nations, and they were scattered throughout the lands. I judged them according to their ways and deeds.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Ezekiel.
God described the people of Israel.
God said He scattered the people of Israel among many nations.
God caused the people of Israel to be spread out in many lands.
God judged the people of Israel.
God judged them based on their ways.
God judged them based on their deeds.
passages.original: וָאָפִ֤יץ אֹתָם֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם וַיִּזָּר֖וּ בָּאֲרָצ֑וֹת כְּדַרְכָּ֥ם וְכַעֲלִילוֹתָ֖ם שְׁפַטְתִּֽים׃

passages.text: And wherever they went among the nations, they profaned My holy name, because it was said of them, ‘These are the people of the LORD, yet they had to leave His land.’
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel went to other nations.
They had left their own land.
Wherever they went, they profaned God's holy name.
The nations said, "These are the people of the LORD."
But the nations also saw that the people of Israel had to leave God's land.
This brought dishonor to God's holy name.
passages.original: וַיָּב֗וֹא אֶל־ הַגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֣אוּ שָׁ֔ם וַֽיְחַלְּל֖וּ אֶת־ שֵׁ֣ם קָדְשִׁ֑י בֶּאֱמֹ֤ר לָהֶם֙ עַם־ יְהוָ֣ה אֵ֔לֶּה וּמֵאַרְצ֖וֹ יָצָֽאוּ׃

passages.text: But I had concern for My holy name, which the house of Israel had profaned among the nations to which they had gone.
passages.sermon:
God is the speaker.
God cares deeply about His holy name.
The house of Israel is God's chosen people.
The house of Israel went to other nations.
The house of Israel profaned God's holy name in those nations.
God showed concern for His holy name because of this.
passages.original: וָאֶחְמֹ֖ל עַל־ שֵׁ֣ם קָדְשִׁ֑י אֲשֶׁ֤ר חִלְּל֙וּהוּ֙ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בַּגּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֥אוּ שָֽׁמָּה׃ס

passages.text: Therefore tell the house of Israel that this is what the Lord GOD says: It is not for your sake that I will act, O house of Israel, but for My holy name, which you profaned among the nations to which you went.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks to the house of Israel.
He says, “I will act now.
I do not act for your sake, house of Israel.
I act for My holy name.
You profaned My holy name among the nations.
You went to those nations and dishonored My name there.”
passages.original: לָכֵ֞ן אֱמֹ֣ר לְבֵֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה לֹ֧א לְמַעַנְכֶ֛ם אֲנִ֥י עֹשֶׂ֖ה בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כִּ֤י אִם־ לְשֵׁם־ קָדְשִׁי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חִלַּלְתֶּ֔ם בַּגּוֹיִ֖ם אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֥אתֶם שָֽׁם׃

passages.text: I will show the holiness of My great name, which has been profaned among the nations—the name you have profaned among them. Then the nations will know that I am the LORD, declares the Lord GOD, when I show My holiness in you before their eyes.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God has a great name.
God’s name is holy.
The house of Israel profaned God’s name among the nations.
God will show the holiness of His great name.
God will do this among the nations.
God will show His holiness in the people of Israel.
God will do this in front of the nations.
Then the nations will know that God is the LORD.
The Lord GOD declares this.
passages.original: וְקִדַּשְׁתִּ֞י אֶת־ שְׁמִ֣י הַגָּד֗וֹל הַֽמְחֻלָּל֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר חִלַּלְתֶּ֖ם בְּתוֹכָ֑ם וְיָדְע֨וּ הַגּוֹיִ֜ם כִּי־ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה בְּהִקָּדְשִׁ֥י בָכֶ֖ם לְעֵינֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: For I will take you from among the nations and gather you out of all the countries, and I will bring you back into your own land.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the house of Israel.
God acts for the sake of His holy name.
God says, "I will take you from among the nations."
I will gather you from all the countries.
I will bring you back into your own land.
passages.original: וְלָקַחְתִּ֤י אֶתְכֶם֙ מִן־ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְקִבַּצְתִּ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם מִכָּל־ הָאֲרָצ֑וֹת וְהֵבֵאתִ֥י אֶתְכֶ֖ם אֶל־ אַדְמַתְכֶֽם׃

passages.text: I will also sprinkle clean water on you, and you will be clean. I will cleanse you from all your impurities and all your idols.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people Israel.
God promises to act.
God says, “I will sprinkle clean water on you.”
You will become clean.
I will cleanse you from all your impurities.
I will cleanse you from all your idols.
passages.original: וְזָרַקְתִּ֧י עֲלֵיכֶ֛ם מַ֥יִם טְהוֹרִ֖ים וּטְהַרְתֶּ֑ם מִכֹּ֧ל טֻמְאוֹתֵיכֶ֛ם וּמִכָּל־ גִּלּ֥וּלֵיכֶ֖ם אֲטַהֵ֥ר אֶתְכֶֽם׃

passages.text: I will give you a new heart and put a new spirit within you; I will remove your heart of stone and give you a heart of flesh.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God promises to act.
God will give you a new heart.
God will put a new spirit within you.
God will remove your heart of stone from your body.
God will give you a heart of flesh.
passages.original: וְנָתַתִּ֤י לָכֶם֙ לֵ֣ב חָדָ֔שׁ וְר֥וּחַ חֲדָשָׁ֖ה אֶתֵּ֣ן בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֑ם וַהֲסִ֨רֹתִ֜י אֶת־ לֵ֤ב הָאֶ֙בֶן֙ מִבְּשַׂרְכֶ֔ם וְנָתַתִּ֥י לָכֶ֖ם לֵ֥ב בָּשָֽׂר׃

passages.text: And I will put My Spirit within you and cause you to walk in My statutes and to carefully observe My ordinances.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God promises to act.
God will put His Spirit inside you.
God will cause you to walk in His statutes.
God will make you keep His ordinances.
God will make you do them.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ רוּחִ֖י אֶתֵּ֣ן בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֑ם וְעָשִׂ֗יתִי אֵ֤ת אֲשֶׁר־ בְּחֻקַּי֙ תֵּלֵ֔כוּ וּמִשְׁפָּטַ֥י תִּשְׁמְר֖וּ וַעֲשִׂיתֶֽם׃

passages.text: Then you will live in the land that I gave your forefathers; you will be My people, and I will be your God.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the people of Israel.
God promised to give them a land.
God had already given this land to their ancestors.
God said, “You will live in this land.”
God said, “You will be My people.”
God said, “I will be your God.”
passages.original: וִישַׁבְתֶּ֣ם בָּאָ֔רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָתַ֖תִּי לַאֲבֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם וִהְיִ֤יתֶם לִי֙ לְעָ֔ם וְאָ֣נֹכִ֔י אֶהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם לֵאלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: I will save you from all your uncleanness. I will summon the grain and make it plentiful, and I will not bring famine upon you.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God promises to save you from all your uncleanness.
God will call for the grain.
God will make the grain plentiful.
God will not bring famine upon you.
passages.original: וְהוֹשַׁעְתִּ֣י אֶתְכֶ֔ם מִכֹּ֖ל טֻמְאֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וְקָרָ֤אתִי אֶל־ הַדָּגָן֙ וְהִרְבֵּיתִ֣י אֹת֔וֹ וְלֹא־ אֶתֵּ֥ן עֲלֵיכֶ֖ם רָעָֽב׃

passages.text: I will also make the fruit of the trees and the crops of the field plentiful, so that you will no longer bear reproach among the nations on account of famine.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God promises to bless them.
God will make the fruit of the trees plentiful.
God will make the crops of the field abundant.
God does this so the people will not suffer shame among the nations.
God will prevent them from being disgraced because of famine.
passages.original: וְהִרְבֵּיתִי֙ אֶת־ פְּרִ֣י הָעֵ֔ץ וּתְנוּבַ֖ת הַשָּׂדֶ֑ה לְמַ֗עַן אֲ֠שֶׁר לֹ֣א תִקְח֥וּ ע֛וֹד חֶרְפַּ֥ת רָעָ֖ב בַּגּוֹיִֽם׃

passages.text: Then you will remember your evil ways and wicked deeds, and you will loathe yourselves for your iniquities and abominations.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God has saved them from their uncleanness.
God has promised to bless their land and remove their shame.
Then the people will remember their evil ways.
They will remember their wicked deeds.
They will see that their actions were not good.
They will feel disgusted with themselves.
They will feel this because of their sins.
They will feel this because of their abominations.
passages.original: וּזְכַרְתֶּם֙ אֶת־ דַּרְכֵיכֶ֣ם הָרָעִ֔ים וּמַעַלְלֵיכֶ֖ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ טוֹבִ֑ים וּנְקֹֽטֹתֶם֙ בִּפְנֵיכֶ֔ם עַ֚ל עֲוֺנֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם וְעַ֖ל תּוֹעֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: It is not for your sake that I will act, declares the Lord GOD—let it be known to you. Be ashamed and disgraced for your ways, O house of Israel!
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks to the house of Israel.
The Lord GOD says, "I will act."
I do not act for your sake.
Let this be known to you.
Be ashamed for your ways.
Be disgraced for your actions, house of Israel.
passages.original: לֹ֧א לְמַעַנְכֶ֣ם אֲנִֽי־ עֹשֶׂ֗ה נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה יִוָּדַ֖ע לָכֶ֑ם בּ֧וֹשׁוּ וְהִכָּלְמ֛וּ מִדַּרְכֵיכֶ֖ם בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

passages.text: This is what the Lord GOD says: On the day I cleanse you from all your iniquities, I will cause the cities to be resettled and the ruins to be rebuilt.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He is holy and powerful.
He promises to act.
He will cleanse you from all your iniquities.
He will remove your sins completely.
On that day, He will act.
He will cause the cities to be resettled.
People will live in them again.
He will rebuild the ruins.
Destroyed places will stand again.
passages.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה בְּיוֹם֙ טַהֲרִ֣י אֶתְכֶ֔ם מִכֹּ֖ל עֲוֺנֽוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם וְהֽוֹשַׁבְתִּי֙ אֶת־ הֶ֣עָרִ֔ים וְנִבְנ֖וּ הֶחֳרָבֽוֹת׃

passages.text: The desolate land will be cultivated instead of lying desolate in the sight of all who pass through.
passages.sermon:
God is speaking to Israel.
The land was empty and ruined.
People saw the land and knew it was desolate.
God will change the land.
The land will be worked and farmed.
It will not stay empty.
Everyone who passes by will see the land is now cultivated.
passages.original: וְהָאָ֥רֶץ הַנְּשַׁמָּ֖ה תֵּֽעָבֵ֑ד תַּ֚חַת אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָיְתָ֣ה שְׁמָמָ֔ה לְעֵינֵ֖י כָּל־ עוֹבֵֽר׃

passages.text: Then they will say, ‘This land that was desolate has become like the garden of Eden. The cities that were once ruined, desolate, and destroyed are now fortified and inhabited.’
passages.sermon:
People will speak about the land.
They will see the land that was once desolate.
They will say, “This land has become like the garden of Eden.”
They will see the cities that were once ruined.
They will see the cities that were once empty and destroyed.
Now these cities are strong.
Now people live in these cities.”
passages.original: וְאָמְר֗וּ הָאָ֤רֶץ הַלֵּ֙זוּ֙ הַנְּשַׁמָּ֔ה הָיְתָ֖ה כְּגַן־ עֵ֑דֶן וְהֶעָרִ֧ים הֶחֳרֵב֛וֹת וְהַֽנְשַׁמּ֥וֹת וְהַנֶּהֱרָס֖וֹת בְּצוּר֥וֹת יָשָֽׁבוּ׃

passages.text: Then the nations around you that remain will know that I, the LORD, have rebuilt what was destroyed, and I have replanted what was desolate. I, the LORD, have spoken, and I will do it.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD has power and authority.
The LORD spoke these words.
The LORD will do what He said.
Some nations will remain around you.
These nations will see what happens.
They will know that the LORD rebuilt what was destroyed.
They will know that the LORD replanted what was desolate.
passages.original: וְיָדְע֣וּ הַגּוֹיִ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִֽשָּׁאֲרוּ֮ סְבִיבוֹתֵיכֶם֒ כִּ֣י׀ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה בָּנִ֙יתִי֙ הַנֶּ֣הֱרָס֔וֹת נָטַ֖עְתִּי הַנְּשַׁמָּ֑ה אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי וְעָשִֽׂיתִי׃ס

passages.text: This is what the Lord GOD says: Once again I will hear the plea of the house of Israel and do for them this: I will multiply their people like a flock.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He is powerful and rules over all.
He says, “I will listen to the house of Israel again.
I will act for them.
I will make their people many.
They will be as many as a flock of sheep.”
passages.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה ע֗וֹד זֹ֛את אִדָּרֵ֥שׁ לְבֵֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לַעֲשׂ֣וֹת לָהֶ֑ם אַרְבֶּ֥ה אֹתָ֛ם כַּצֹּ֖אן אָדָֽם׃

passages.text: Like the numerous flocks for sacrifices at Jerusalem during her appointed feasts, so the ruined cities will be filled with flocks of people. Then they will know that I am the LORD.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
He restores what was ruined.
He fills empty places with people.
During the feasts in Jerusalem, many holy flocks gather for sacrifice.
In the same way, the ruined cities will be full of people.
These people will be as many as the flocks in Jerusalem at the feasts.
Then everyone will know that the LORD is God.
passages.original: כְּצֹ֣אן קָֽדָשִׁ֗ים כְּצֹ֤אן יְרוּשָׁלִַ֙ם֙ בְּמ֣וֹעֲדֶ֔יהָ כֵּ֤ן תִּהְיֶ֙ינָה֙ הֶעָרִ֣ים הֶחֳרֵב֔וֹת מְלֵא֖וֹת צֹ֣אן אָדָ֑ם וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס
